aka.zh: 环球小姐公路（1960 年的名称）

tagline.en: A spur of US 1 that grew at both ends into the Sarasota-to-Delaware bypass of Washington and Baltimore
tagline.zh: 一条 US 1 支线，两端不断延长，终成自萨拉索塔至特拉华、绕开华盛顿与巴尔的摩的通道

start.zh: 佛罗里达州萨拉索塔，与 US 41 相接

end.en: DE 1 at Biddles Corner, Delaware, south of the Chesapeake and Delaware Canal
end.zh: 特拉华州比德尔斯角，切萨皮克—特拉华运河以南，与 DE 1 相接

en: US 301 is numbered as a branch of US 1 and runs through seven states, Florida, Georgia, South Carolina, North Carolina, Virginia, Maryland and Delaware. In Florida it comes up from Sarasota and Bradenton, skirts Tampa, and runs inland through Zephyrhills, Dade City, Ocala, Starke and Baldwin; in Georgia through Jesup, Claxton and Statesboro; in South Carolina through Allendale, Bamberg and Orangeburg, across Lake Marion with I-95 and on by Manning and Florence to the South of the Border complex at the North Carolina line.

From there to Petersburg, Virginia, it is the old road beside I-95, through Lumberton, Fayetteville, Dunn, Smithfield, Wilson, Rocky Mount, Weldon and Emporia, often serving as the Interstate's frontage road. North of Richmond it leaves I-95 and heads north-east through Bowling Green to Dahlgren, where it crosses the Potomac on the Nice/Middleton Bridge.

The Maryland and Delaware end is what makes it a through route. As the Crain Highway it runs through La Plata, Waldorf and Upper Marlboro to Bowie, joins US 50 over the Chesapeake Bay Bridge, then crosses the Eastern Shore and enters Delaware as a tolled freeway round Middletown. For traffic between Philadelphia and points south, that line avoids the Washington and Baltimore beltways altogether, and trucks use it heavily.
zh: US 301 按编号是 US 1 的一条支线，途经佛罗里达、佐治亚、南卡罗来纳、北卡罗来纳、弗吉尼亚、马里兰与特拉华七个州。在佛罗里达，它自萨拉索塔与布雷登顿北上，绕过坦帕，经内陆的泽弗希尔斯、戴德城、奥卡拉、斯塔克与鲍德温；在佐治亚经杰瑟普、克拉克斯顿与斯泰茨伯勒；在南卡罗来纳经阿伦代尔、班伯格与奥兰治堡，随 I-95 跨过马里昂湖，再经曼宁与弗洛伦斯到达北卡罗来纳州界的“边境以南”游乐区。
从那里到弗吉尼亚州彼得斯堡，它是 I-95 旁边的老路，经拉姆伯顿、费耶特维尔、邓恩、史密斯菲尔德、威尔逊、洛基芒特、韦尔登与恩波里亚，常常充当州际公路的辅道。里士满以北，它离开 I-95，向东北经鲍灵格林到达尔格伦，经奈斯/米德尔顿大桥跨过波托马克河。
马里兰与特拉华这一端，才使它成为一条过境干道。它以“克兰公路”之名经拉普拉塔、沃尔多夫与上马尔伯勒到鲍伊，随 US 50 跨过切萨皮克湾大桥，再横穿东岸地区，以收费高速公路的形式绕过米德尔敦进入特拉华。对于往来费城与南方各地的车流，这条线完全避开了华盛顿与巴尔的摩的环城公路，卡车使用尤多。

en: US 301 was created in 1932 out of US 217, an original 1926 route from Pee Dee, South Carolina, to Wilson, North Carolina, and the stretch of US 17-1 north of Wilson. It ran from Pee Dee to US 1 at Petersburg, a line I-95 now follows the whole way. It then grew in both directions: in 1935 south-west to Summerton; north in late 1940, when the Potomac River Bridge opened, through Richmond and Bowling Green and on to Baltimore; in the late 1940s south through Georgia and Florida to Tampa; and in the early 1950s to Sarasota.

In 1960 it took its present line in Maryland, giving the Bowie–Baltimore section back to MD 3 and following US 50 over the Chesapeake Bay Bridge to Queenstown and across the Eastern Shore into Delaware. The same year it was officially renamed the Miss Universe Highway, reportedly replacing the name Tobacco Trail. Its Delaware end shifted several times, and in 1992 AASHTO fixed it on DE 896 to US 40 at Glasgow.

A bypass of Middletown had been proposed since the 1950s. DelDOT chose a route on 14 November 2006, west of the town and then north-east to DE 1 near the Biddles Corner toll plaza, to be tolled like DE 1 and I-95 to pay for its construction. The four-lane toll road opened on 10 January 2019 and became US 301.
zh: US 301 设立于 1932 年，由 US 217（1926 年的首批路线之一，自南卡罗来纳州皮迪至北卡罗来纳州威尔逊）和 US 17-1 在威尔逊以北的路段合并而成。它当时自皮迪通至彼得斯堡的 US 1，这条线如今全程都有 I-95 并行。此后它向两个方向延伸：1935 年向西南至萨默顿；1940 年末波托马克河大桥通车时向北经里士满与鲍灵格林直达巴尔的摩；1940 年代末向南穿过佐治亚与佛罗里达到坦帕；1950 年代初到萨拉索塔。
1960 年，它在马里兰改走今天的线位：鲍伊至巴尔的摩一段交还 MD 3，转而随 US 50 跨过切萨皮克湾大桥到昆斯敦，再横穿东岸进入特拉华。同年，它被正式改名为“环球小姐公路”，据称取代了“烟草之路”这一旧称。它在特拉华的终点几经变动，1992 年 AASHTO 将其定在沿 DE 896 至格拉斯哥的 US 40。
米德尔敦绕城路自 1950 年代起就有人提出。2006 年 11 月 14 日，特拉华州交通部选定线位：从镇西绕过，再向东北接比德尔斯角收费站附近的 DE 1，并像 DE 1 与 I-95 那样收费以支付建设费用。这条四车道收费公路于 2019 年 1 月 10 日通车，成为 US 301。

en: The route's one large federal-era structure is its Potomac crossing. The first bridge, begun in March 1938 at a ground-breaking presided over by President Roosevelt and opened in December 1940 as the Potomac River Bridge, cost $5 million; it was the first highway link between Maryland and Virginia south of Washington, and the crossing is still tolled. By the 2000s its single narrow lane each way, with no shoulders, made it a bottleneck.

Its replacement shows how long such decisions take. The Maryland Transportation Authority began studying it in 2006, estimated a new span at about $850 million in 2012, and on 21 November 2016 its board voted to build a four-lane bridge, reported at $765 million after redesigns that dropped the planned walking and cycling path. Construction began in July 2020 and the bridge opened on 13 October 2022; the old one was demolished from March 2023 and its rubble used for an artificial reef.
zh: 这条路线在联邦时代的唯一一座大型构造物是它的波托马克河过河桥。第一座桥于 1938 年 3 月动工，由罗斯福总统主持奠基，1940 年 12 月以“波托马克河大桥”之名通车，造价 500 万美元；它是华盛顿以南第一条连接马里兰与弗吉尼亚的公路通道，这一过河通道至今仍收费。到 2000 年代，它单向仅一条窄车道、没有路肩，成了瓶颈。
它的替换工程说明了这类决策要花多长时间。马里兰交通管理局 2006 年开始研究，2012 年估计新桥约需 8.5 亿美元；2016 年 11 月 21 日，其董事会表决修建一座四车道新桥，经过取消原定步行与自行车道等设计修改后，据报造价 7.65 亿美元。工程于 2020 年 7 月开工，新桥于 2022 年 10 月 13 日通车；旧桥自 2023 年 3 月起拆除，残骸用于建造人工鱼礁。

why.en: No figure exists for the route. US 301 was assembled from 1932 to 1960 out of existing state roads and older US routes, and has been rebuilt by seven states project by project; only individual works such as the Potomac bridges are costed on their own.
why.zh: 全线并无造价数据。US 301 于 1932 至 1960 年间由既有州道与更早的美国国道拼接而成，此后由七个州逐个项目改建；只有波托马克河大桥这类单项工程留有独立造价。

why.en: There is no single funder. Each state maintains its own section with state and federal-aid money; the Potomac bridge is run by the toll-funded Maryland Transportation Authority, and the Delaware section was built as a toll road to pay for itself.
why.zh: 没有单一出资方。各州以州资金与联邦补助资金养护本州路段；波托马克河大桥由依靠通行费运营的马里兰交通管理局管理，特拉华段则作为收费公路修建，以通行费自偿。

label.zh: 波托马克河大桥（奈斯大桥），1940 年

value.en: $5 million, built March 1938 to December 1940, 1.7 miles long
value.zh: 500 万美元，1938 年 3 月至 1940 年 12 月修建，全长 1.7 英里

figures.source: Maryland Transportation Authority, Harry W. Nice Memorial Bridge page, as cited in English Wikipedia

value.en: Reported at $765 million when approved by the MDTA board on 21 November 2016; earlier estimate about $850 million (2012); opened 13 October 2022. Not checked against the authority's final accounts
value.zh: 2016 年 11 月 21 日马里兰交通管理局董事会批准时据报 7.65 亿美元；此前 2012 年估计约 8.5 亿美元；2022 年 10 月 13 日通车。未与该局决算核对

figures.source: WTOP, 21 November 2016; Maryland Transportation Authority release, December 2012; both as cited in English Wikipedia, Harry W. Nice Memorial Bridge

value.en: Reported at 1,099 miles, the sum of a state-by-state table in English Wikipedia; not checked against state route logs
value.zh: 据报 1,099 英里，系英文维基百科分州表格之和；未与各州路线里程表核对

why.en: Seven state agencies count their own sections, and the route shares pavement with I-95 and US 50 in places. No combined figure is published.
why.zh: 7 个州的机构各自统计本州路段，部分路段又与 I-95、US 50 共用路面。并无合并数字发布。

timeline.en: US 217 is numbered from Pee Dee, South Carolina, to Wilson, North Carolina.
timeline.zh: US 217 编定，自南卡罗来纳州皮迪至北卡罗来纳州威尔逊。

timeline.en: US 301 replaces US 217 and part of US 17-1, running from Pee Dee to Petersburg, Virginia.
timeline.zh: US 301 取代 US 217 与 US 17-1 的一部分，自皮迪通至弗吉尼亚州彼得斯堡。

timeline.en: The route is extended south-west to Summerton, South Carolina.
timeline.zh: 路线向西南延伸至南卡罗来纳州萨默顿。

timeline.en: The Potomac River Bridge opens in December and US 301 is extended north to Baltimore.
timeline.zh: 12 月波托马克河大桥通车，US 301 向北延伸至巴尔的摩。

timeline.en: US 301 is moved across the Chesapeake Bay Bridge and the Eastern Shore into Delaware, and renamed the Miss Universe Highway.
timeline.zh: US 301 改经切萨皮克湾大桥与东岸进入特拉华，并改名为“环球小姐公路”。

timeline.en: AASHTO fixes the northern end on DE 896 at US 40 in Glasgow, Delaware.
timeline.zh: AASHTO 将北端定在沿 DE 896 至特拉华州格拉斯哥的 US 40。

timeline.en: DelDOT selects the route of a tolled Middletown bypass on 14 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 14 日，特拉华州交通部选定米德尔敦收费绕城路的线位。

timeline.en: The Maryland Transportation Authority board votes on 21 November to replace the Nice Bridge.
timeline.zh: 11 月 21 日，马里兰交通管理局董事会表决替换奈斯大桥。

timeline.en: The US 301 toll road in Delaware opens on 10 January, ending the route at DE 1.
timeline.zh: 1 月 10 日，特拉华州的 US 301 收费公路通车，路线改止于 DE 1。

timeline.en: The new Nice/Middleton Bridge opens on 13 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 13 日，新奈斯/米德尔顿大桥通车。
